title: Grant Management Software Landscape for Clinical Trials
summary: Competitive landscape of grant management and clinical trial budgeting software covering investigator payment and study budget workflows.

findings.market_overview: Grant management software addresses clinical trial budget creation, negotiation, FMV data, and investigator payment workflows. Dominated by specialized PE-backed vendors with $55-65M revenue for leaders.
findings.fmv_data_differentiator: Leading vendors derive FMV benchmarks from actual negotiated clinical trial agreements across hundreds of clients, more accurate than survey-based approaches.
findings.integration_requirements: Tools integrate with CTMS for study milestones, finance/ERP for payment processing, IRT for visit completion triggers, and CRM for investigator relationship context.
findings.market_dynamics: PE investment driving consolidation. Leading vendor acquired for $1.1B. Growth rates exceed 100% over 3 years for market leaders.
findings.hcp_payment_connection: Directly connects to HCP payment transparency reporting. CRM systems managing HCP relationships need visibility into investigator payment data for compliance.

source: Competitive landscape of grant management software providers for clinical trials
